stage1.cases: All eight official Brian2 published firing-pattern dictionaries, once each; no chosen mentor parameters or replicated lane padding.
stage1.numeric_reference: Official Euler method, dt0.1ms,0.6seconds,VinitialEL,winitial0,V>0mV crossing,VresetVr,wjumpb; preserve all published inputs/parameters.
stage1.claims_allowed: Software model applicability and range opportunity only; no trained-model accuracy, integer exactness or measured packing gain.
claims_disallowed: Continuous ODE exactness from finite-step solver
Duplicated single-neuron traces called an eight-lane real workload

requires: Application integer equation/discretization, or an explicitly identified independent published fixed-point reference
Ordered independent neuron workload with genuine coefficient-sharing conditions
stage2_gate.action: Only then emit an integer ledger and compare actual packed sums plus both states/spikes to its plain-integer reference.
preserve_controls: Native signed SIMD plus LUT remainder
Constant factorization and ROM/table where legal
Exact high-product correction and relevant spill-tracking alternatives

contribution_gate.current_addition: Fixed8 achieves ceil(N/8)requests per group; any adaptive take<=8 cannot beat that in the same capacity/latency interface.
contribution_gate.conditional_untested_operation: Invariant-layout intrinsic coefficient product using actual-state admission, only for a genuinely needed non-shift coefficient under a declared fixed resource envelope.
unknowns: Integer AdEx exponential and product precision
Tail eligibility in independent neuron workload
Strongest fixed/LUT/ROM product cost and natural latency
contribution_gate.stop_before_RTL_if: The legal fixed product frontier or supply bound removes the plausible measurable adaptive benefit.

execution_constraints: No vendor job, no accelerator, no package/model/data download or old evidence mutation in this review.
